purpose: Maintain a public-professional watchlist of scholars who may be useful reviewers once TOPA has a reproducible result worth sharing.
privacy_rule: Store only public professional identity, role, relevance and institutional/profile source. Resolve current contact details only at outreach time.
global_contact_gate: No outreach for a motif claim before frozen source loci and provenance packets exist.
No outreach describing a mysterious residual before blind scoring and matched controls are complete.
Negative or null results are shareable if methodologically complete.
Send the smallest relevant packet for the recipient's specialty rather than the whole JANUS corpus.

A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.name: Enrique Jiménez
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.current_public_role: Professor of Ancient Near Eastern Literatures, LMU Munich; leader of Electronic Babylonian Literature (eBL)
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.why_relevant: Combines Assyriology, digital corpora and AI-assisted reconstruction of Babylonian literature; especially relevant to manuscript/root collapse and Akkadian source packets.
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.best_share_trigger: A reproducible Atrahasis/Gilgamesh packet with exact tablets, lines, transliterations, source-root rules and an algorithmic false-positive audit.

A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.name: Andrew R. George
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.current_public_role: Professor of Babylonian, SOAS University of London
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.why_relevant: Author of the major critical edition of the Babylonian Gilgamesh Epic; ideal specialist for whether TOPA has encoded Tablet XI responsibly.
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.best_share_trigger: Exact Gilgamesh XI feature packet plus sensitivity analysis showing that results do not depend on modern translation vocabulary.

A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.name: Irving Finkel
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.current_public_role: Assistant Keeper, Mesopotamian cultures, Department of the Middle East, British Museum
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.why_relevant: Cuneiform specialist and author of The Ark Before Noah; directly relevant to Mesopotamian flood traditions and tablet-level provenance.
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.best_share_trigger: A tablet-grounded Flood calibration report with British Museum object identifiers and no claim beyond textual/historical inference.

A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.name: Konrad Schmid
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.current_public_role: Professor of Hebrew Bible and Ancient Judaism, University of Zurich
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.why_relevant: Works on Hebrew Bible literary history, dating and ancient contexts; highly relevant to Genesis composition and chronology gates.
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.best_share_trigger: Genesis 6-9 final-form versus source-stratified sensitivity results with explicit dating uncertainty.

A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.name: Joshua Berman
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.why_relevant: Has published specifically on the limits of source criticism using Genesis 6-9 as a test case; useful adversarial reviewer against overconfident source decomposition.
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.best_share_trigger: The Genesis dual-model sensitivity packet, especially if source partition materially changes clustering.

A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.name: Gabriel Said Reynolds
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.current_public_role: Jerome J. Crowley and Rosaleen G. Crowley Professor of Theology, University of Notre Dame
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.why_relevant: Researches the Qur'an in relation to Biblical and Late Antique traditions; directly relevant to preventing false independence claims between Qur'anic and Biblical material.
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.best_share_trigger: Qur'anic Noah contact-graph packet and comparison showing exactly what is treated as dependence, context or unresolved similarity.

A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.name: Nicolai Sinai
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.current_public_role: Professor of Islamic Studies, University of Oxford; Fellow of Pembroke College
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.why_relevant: Historical-critical and literary study of the Qur'an, intertextuality, chronology and key-term semantics; ideal for Arabic ontology and chronology gates.
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.best_share_trigger: Arabic-first Noah feature encoding with passage-boundary sensitivity and Late Antique contact nulls.

A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.name: Michael Marx
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.current_public_role: Editor/research coordinator associated with Corpus Coranicum; continuing Corpus Coranicum digital publication since 2025
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.why_relevant: Early Qur'anic manuscript evidence, variant readings and digital transmission history; useful for source-surface and manuscript controls.
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.best_share_trigger: A Qur'an packet tied to manuscript/reading evidence rather than only a modern normalized text.

A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.name: Michael Witzel
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.current_public_role: Wales Research Professor of Sanskrit, Harvard University
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.why_relevant: Vedic language, literature, philology, manuscripts and comparative mythology; directly relevant to Satapatha Brahmana and Manu-flood source control.
A_SOURCE_AND_TEXT_SPECIALISTS.best_share_trigger: A Sanskrit-first Satapatha Brahmana 1.8.1 packet with recension, dating uncertainty and later-retelling collapse.

B_METHOD_AND_COMPUTATIONAL_REVIEWERS.name: Jamshid Tehrani
B_METHOD_AND_COMPUTATIONAL_REVIEWERS.current_public_role: Professor, Department of Anthropology, Durham University
B_METHOD_AND_COMPUTATIONAL_REVIEWERS.why_relevant: Studies cultural transmission and evolution of folk narratives using comparative/phylogenetic methods; highly relevant to separating inheritance, borrowing and convergence.
B_METHOD_AND_COMPUTATIONAL_REVIEWERS.best_share_trigger: Blind clustering methodology, null-model design and leave-one-feature-family-out results rather than theological interpretation.

B_METHOD_AND_COMPUTATIONAL_REVIEWERS.name: Julien d'Huy
B_METHOD_AND_COMPUTATIONAL_REVIEWERS.current_public_role: Researcher affiliated with the Laboratoire d'Anthropologie Sociale, Collège de France/EHESS/CNRS
B_METHOD_AND_COMPUTATIONAL_REVIEWERS.why_relevant: Applies phylogenetic approaches to comparative mythology and explicitly studies how geographically separated myth variants may preserve historical relationships.
B_METHOD_AND_COMPUTATIONAL_REVIEWERS.best_share_trigger: Cross-tradition residual methodology after Q01 and Q02 calibration, including controls against analyst-created motif trees.

B_METHOD_AND_COMPUTATIONAL_REVIEWERS.name: Wido van Peursen
B_METHOD_AND_COMPUTATIONAL_REVIEWERS.current_public_role: Current staff, Eep Talstra Centre for Bible and Computer, Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam
B_METHOD_AND_COMPUTATIONAL_REVIEWERS.why_relevant: Computational analysis of the Hebrew Bible; ETCBC/DAST explicitly combines sacred-text scholarship with computational linguistics and expands beyond Hebrew to Sanskrit, Arabic, Syriac and Greek.
B_METHOD_AND_COMPUTATIONAL_REVIEWERS.best_share_trigger: Machine-readable Hebrew feature extraction, reproducible code and evidence that semantic clustering is not overriding formal textual structure.

order: Send source-specific packet to one domain specialist first.
Send method-only packet to one computational/cultural-transmission reviewer independently.
Record criticisms before contacting the next reviewer.
Do not quote one scholar's reaction to prime another scholar unless permission and context make it appropriate.
first_contact_strategy_when_ready.request_language: We built a preregistered falsification-first comparison and would value criticism of the source model/method. We are not asking for endorsement or a metaphysical conclusion.
first_contact_strategy_when_ready.success: A reviewer identifies a falsifier, missing source, coding defect, or confirms that the packet is worth deeper scholarly inspection.
first_contact_strategy_when_ready.failure: Outreach is framed as proof of a hidden universal message, asks scholars to validate JANUS as authority, or sends a huge unfocused repository dump.
